description: This file defines the interface for the SSP message bus component, including function declarations for engaging, initializing, finalizing, checking, and freeing resources related to the message bus. It also declares a boolean function for waiting on a condition. The file includes licensing information, documentation comments, and include guards.
external_methods: BOOLEAN waitConditionReady(void*, const char*, char*, char*)

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages or initializes the message bus component with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Performs initialization of the message bus interface with optional user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Performs cleanup and finalization of the message bus interface with optional user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus with optional user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus, given a priority and user data.

methods.name: waitConditionReady
methods.description: Waits for a specific condition to be ready on the message bus, given handles, component IDs, and paths.

calls: BOOLEAN waitConditionReady(void*, const char*, char*, char*)
